howto.when: 当你要求设计API、审查端点结构、定义请求/响应模式，或改进API易用性时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design or review REST and GraphQL APIs following best practices: resource paths, request/response schemas, error contracts, pagination, and versioning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design an API, review endpoints, define schemas, or improve API ergonomics.
